deploy-bot: queued deploy service=llm-router v=2.5.0; FF plan `llmroute_v2_toggle`: 2%->10%->50%->100%; auto-quarantine enabled. change window 03:00-05:00 UTC.
diana: release note: routing fallback + model pin. https://redwood-internal/release/llm-router/2.5.0
josh: watchers set: p99, client-errors, token-cost. thresholds: p99>900ms or client-errors>0.5% = quarantine.
qa-lead: staging smoke ok; running targeted soak on enterprise prompts.
release-manager: starting 2% canary now. will wait 5m then 10%. manual ack at 50%.
deploy-bot: rolled 2% -> cohorts c-a; routing pinned.
diana: 10% shows rare null-field for prompt cu-771; reproducer in REL-882.
josh: affects enterprise parser. options: hotfix (long) or surgical exclusion (fast).
qa-lead: we can exclude affected customer IDs via FF rules to keep ramp for others.
release-manager: approve surgical exclusion. apply FF exclusion for [cust-102,cust-305,cust-411,cust-502]. pin cohorts and disable auto-unpin.
deploy-bot: updated `llmroute_v2_toggle` to exclude listed IDs. ramp -> 50% initiated for eligible traffic.
infra-oncall: monitoring. excluded customers routed to v1 as expected.
josh: opened HOTFIX ticket for tokenizer edge-case; ETA 4h.
release-manager: proceed to 100% for eligible cohorts after hold if metrics stable. post-rollout note will mention targeted exclusion and upcoming fix. thread closed.
